You grade the output of one AI step in an English listening course for Taiwanese students (high school or university, around CEFR B1).
You get: the step, its input, the output after the app's own checks, and the criteria to grade by (in Traditional Chinese).
Grade only by the criteria. Score 1 to 5: 5 = fully meets them, a teacher would use it as is; 4 = small issues; 3 = usable but a teacher would fix something; 2 = a real error a learner could learn wrong; 1 = wrong or unusable.
Be strict about facts: a wrong meaning, a wrong grammar explanation, or a sound change that doesn't happen is at most 2.
Give reason: one or two short sentences in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) naming the most important issue, or what makes it good.

{"operation":"compose","input":{"topic":"","scenario":"a manager explaining a change in the work schedule","level":"CEFR B2 to C1: natural, varied vocabulary and sentence structure","words":200,"format":"monologue"},"output":{"text":{"title":"Adjusting the Work Schedule","titleZh":"调整工作時程","subtitle":"經理說明工作時程的變動和原因。","text":"Good morning everyone, I want to explain a change to our work schedule starting next month.
We have reviewed project timelines and staffing and need better coverage during peak hours.
Beginning the first Monday of the month, the office will open at 8:00 instead of 9:00 on weekdays.
This shift means some teams will start earlier while others keep their current times.
We will introduce staggered lunch breaks to avoid crowding and maintain productivity.
Each department head will propose a rotation pattern by Friday so we can finalize the schedule.
If you are scheduled for an earlier start, you will finish earlier on most days.
Overtime will be assigned only when necessary and paid according to our existing policy.
Please tell your manager any constraints, such as childcare or commuting issues, by Wednesday.
We will consider reasonable accommodations to minimize disruptions to your routines.
To support the change, the company will provide a commuter subsidy for eligible employees for three months.
We will also offer an information session next Tuesday to answer questions and explain the rotation tool.
I understand adjustments can be inconvenient, but this change will help balance workloads and meet deadlines.
Better coverage during peak hours should reduce stress and improve response times to clients.
Please check the shared calendar for proposed shifts and submit feedback as soon as possible.
Thank you for your attention and for helping us make this schedule work for everyone.","category":"business"},"firstWords":264},"criteria":"內容符合情境（主管說明班表變動），程度符合 高級 B2～C1，英文自然正確、適合學生；中文標題與副標正確通順。"}

message.content: {"score":5,"reason":"內容清楚完整，語氣適合主管宣布變動，英文語法與用字自然，符合 B2–C1 程度；中文標題與副標也正確通順，可直接使用。"}
